dict.string: Toaster's player bar asks Music or Spotify to play, pause or skip, and how far into the song it is, when one of them is what you're listening to.
Toaster listens to whatever this Mac is playing, so it can write it out as code. It uses the sound only.
Toaster uses the camera for the picture behind the code, the finger frame and the now-playing card. The picture stays on this Mac.
Toaster listens to a microphone or line-in when you pick an audio input.
